console_ip.description: IP address for the TCP/IP console interface (see hercules.cnf(5), CONSOLE directive)

console_port.description: Port number for the TCP/IP console interface (see hercules.cnf(5), CONSOLE directive)

config_file_path.description: Alternative configuration file path (see hercules(1), -f option; hercules.cnf(5), CONFIG directive)

network_devices.description: List of network and I/O devices (see hercules.cnf(5), device directives: 3088, 3270, 3505, 1403, etc.)

cpus.description: List of CPU configurations (see hercules.cnf(5), CPU directive)

memory_size.description: Main storage size in kilobytes (see hercules.cnf(5), MAINSTOR directive)

log_dir.description: Directory for log files (see hercules.cnf(5), LOGDIR directive)

log_file.description: Log file path (see hercules.cnf(5), LOGFILE directive)
